{{ block title }} Welcome! {{ endblock }} {{ block content }}

In the experiment today, you will participate in two tasks, a Production Task and a Visual Perception Task. In each of the two tasks you can earn experimental points. At the end of the experiment, the points that you obtain during each of the two tasks will be added together to determine your final experimental score.

Your Experimental Score = Points from Production Task + Points from Visual Perception Task

How will your payment be determined?

In this experiment, you will be matched with another person who is participating in this experiment. You will both complete exactly the same tasks. At the end of the experiment, your Experimental Score will be compared with the Experimental Score of your matched partner. The person who has the higher Experimental Score will earn a bonus payment for the experiment. The person who has the lower Experimental Score will not earn a bonus payment for the experiment.

For the person who has the higher Experimental Score, their bonus payment will be calculated in the following way. At the end of the experiment, their points will be converted into a monetary bonus payment using the exchange rate of 100 Experimental Points = GBP 2.00. In addition, both you and your matched partner will be paid a show-up fee of GBP 1.30 for participating in the experiment.

Calculation of the payment of the person who has the higher Experimental Score

$$ \text{Payment} = \text{GBP } 1.30 + \text{GBP} \left(2\times\frac{\text{Experimental Points}}{100}\right)$$

Calculation of the payment of the person who has the lower Experimental Score

$$ \text{Payment} = \text{GBP } 1.30$$
